title: Enterprise Account Director
description: About Us Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. Your Mission As an Enterprise Account Director, you will play a pivotal role in expanding Hawk's presence across leading financial institutions, Tier 1 banks, payment providers, and other regulated organizations throughout EMEA You will drive complex enterprise sales engagements, build trusted executive relationships, and help customers transform their financial crime operations through Hawk's AI-supported AML and fraud prevention platform. Working closely with executive stakeholders, you will lead strategic opportunities from initial engagement through contract execution, helping customers leverage explainable AI, intelligent investigation workflows, and emerging agentic AI capabilities to improve detection, reduce false positives, and increase operational efficiency. Your Responsibilities Identify, develop, and close new enterprise opportunities with Tier 1 banks, financial institutions, payment providers, and other regulated organizations across EMEA. Build and execute strategic account plans to acquire new customers and expand existing relationships within target accounts. Establish trusted advisor relationships with executive stakeholders, including C-suite leaders, Heads of AML, Fraud, Compliance, Financial Crime, Risk, Operations, and Technology. Lead complex enterprise sales cycles from prospecting through negotiation, procurement, legal review, and contract execution. Conduct consultative discovery to understand customer challenges and position Hawk's AI-supported AML, fraud detection, transaction monitoring, and financial crime solutions to deliver measurable business outcomes. Partner with customers to explore innovative AI use cases, including agentic workflows, intelligent investigation automation, and AI-assisted decision support, that improve operational efficiency and financial crime detection. Develop compelling executive presentations, business cases, and solution strategies tailored to the needs of large financial institutions and payment providers. Generate and nurture pipeline through strategic prospecting, executive networking, industry conferences, partner relationships, and targeted outbound campaigns. Collaborate closely with Pre-Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success teams to design solutions, execute proof-of-value engagements, and deliver successful customer outcomes. Translate customer feedback and market insights into actionable recommendations that influence product strategy, AI capabilities, and future platform innovation. Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasting, opportunity planning, and account activity within CRM systems (e.g., HubSpot). Drive disciplined opportunity management using a value-based, data-driven sales methodology to consistently advance complex enterprise opportunities. Lead commercial negotiations while balancing customer requirements with Hawk's strategic and commercial objectives. Develop long-term account growth strategies that drive expansion, customer retention, and increased lifetime value. Stay current on industry trends, evolving financial crime typologies, AI innovation, regulatory developments, and the competitive landscape to effectively position Hawk in the market. Represent Hawk at executive briefings, customer events, industry conferences, and thought leadership forums across the financial services ecosystem. Your Profile 7+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience, with a proven track record of exceeding quota and closing complex, high-value enterprise deals. Experience selling into Tier 1 banks, large financial institutions, or payment providers, engaging executive stakeholders across Risk, Compliance, Fraud, AML, and Technology functions. Strong understanding of RegTech, financial crime compliance, fraud prevention, AI-powered transaction monitoring, or enterprise AI workflow solutions, with the ability to position modern AI capabilities, including agentic AI and workflow automation, to solve complex business challenges. Demonstrated consultative selling and strategic account management experience, navigating long enterprise sales cycles, multi-stakeholder buying committees, and value-based solution selling. Exceptional executive presence, negotiation, and communication skills, with the ability to build trusted advisor relationships with C-level and senior business leaders. Experience collaborating across Sales, Pre-Sales, Product, and Customer Success teams to develop tailored solutions and successfully execute complex enterprise engagements. Proficiency with CRM platforms and Microsoft Office Suite (particularly Excel and PowerPoint) for pipeline management, forecasting, and executive presentations. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth, global environment, managing multiple strategic opportunities while adapting to evolving customer needs and market dynamics. Willingness to travel as needed for customer meetings, executive briefings, industry events, and internal collaboration. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: About Doit We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. title: Director, Localisation & Operations - Europe
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 data-pm-slice="1 1 []">About Crunchyroll</h2> <p>Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.</p> <p>Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!</p></div><h2><strong>Role Overview</strong></h2> <p>Crunchyroll is looking for an operational leader to serve as <strong>Director, Localisation & Operations</strong>. In this role, you will be responsible for building, scaling, and leading a multi-disciplinary team driving three core operational pillars: regional dubbing operations, platform content operations, and localized marketing operations. You will ensure that every piece of content—from full-length episodic anime to promotional trailers and fan communications—is delivered on time, at peak technical quality, and in an authentic local tone of voice. </p> <p>This role is ideal for an experienced media and post-production operations executive who thrives in ambiguity and enjoys bringing structure to a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment. You are a builder at heart—someone who takes end-to-end ownership of complex challenges, isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves to optimize legacy systems, and excels at architecting robust, scalable processes from the ground up. You combine structured, data-driven leadership with a deep passion for global content regionalization, and you excel at evaluating complex vendor partnerships, establishing rigorous quality control standards, and building seamless workflows in fast-paced environments. </p> <p>You will be responsible for shaping Crunchyroll’s European operations collaborating cross-functionally with Global Centre’s of Excellence, Content Acquisition, Growth, Marketing teams to ensure anime fans in Europe enjoy premium, culturally nuanced experiences. </p> <h2><strong>The Localisation & Operations Team </strong></h2> <p>The Localisation & Operations team serves as the operational backbone powering Crunchyroll’s European business. By bridging raw media assets with multi-language execution, the team ensures millions of subscribers and territories receive synchronized, high-quality audio, subtitle, and marketing deliverables. The team’s mandate is to uphold localized creative integrity, optimize operational efficiency, and elevate brand authenticity to super-serve anime fans in Europe. </p> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Regional Dubbing Operations & Vendor Strategy </strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead the regional dubbing operational strategy, setting gold-standard benchmarks for quality across titles.</li> <li>Source, evaluate, and manage ongoing relationships with external dubbing studios, post-production houses, and localisation agencies in the region.</li> <li>Lead vendor negotiations to secure market-competitive rates, scalable capacity, and strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) across multi-language projects.</li> <li>Establish comprehensive Quality Control (QC) frameworks for dubbing assets to guarantee linguistic fidelity, regional slang/nuance accuracy, lip-sync alignment, and audio master standards.</li> <li>Monitor vendor throughput, turnaround times, and error rates, implementing continuous process improvements for simuldub and deep catalog localization pipelines.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Content Operations, Ingestion & Scheduling </strong></h3> <ul> <li>Maintain a clear view of readiness across upcoming regional releases, including content assets, localized components, metadata, regulatory requirements, rights/avails, partner specifications, and publishing dependencies. Identify gaps early and coordinate resolution before they impact fans or partners.</li> <li>Ensure all regionally required components are correctly ingested, associated, and published, including subtitles, dubs, closed captions, audio descriptions, localized metadata, and required regulatory or content-classification tags. </li> <li>Partner closely with Global Operations on title schedules, rights and avails, material readiness, asset availability, and technical requirements. </li> <li>Work closely with Global Localization and Regional Localization to ensure required localized outputs are available against regional launch schedules. </li> <li>Partner with Regional Marketing and other regional stakeholders to translate regional programming and launch priorities into operational schedules and delivery requirements.</li> <li> Track regional content-operations performance including on-time availability, publishing accuracy, delivery failures, remediation time, partner issues, and recurring defects. Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, eliminate manual work, and improve global-to-regional handoffs while adopting common global standards, tools, and operating practices.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Marketing Operations & Asset Localisation QC  </strong></h3> <ul> <li>Oversee marketing asset localization operations, managing the pipeline for trailers, teasers, key art, digital banners, and social collateral across our key European territories.</li> <li>Enforce rigorous QC across all customer-facing communications, ensuring localized copy, tone of voice, and brand messaging resonate natively within each specific market context.</li> <li>Develop agile asset workflows capable of delivering rapid-turnaround localized creative materials for regional promotional initiatives.</li> <li>Oversee the localization workflow for all global and regional marketing assets required by the Region, including copy, key art, trailers, video, social assets, paid-media creative, CRM materials, partner assets, promotional content, and other campaign deliverables.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Team Leadership & Operational Governance   </strong></h3> <ul> <li>Build, mentor, and direct a high-performing operations team spanning dubbing, content ingestion, and marketing ops functions, fostering a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.</li> <li>Define, track, and report on primary operational KPIs (e.g., fulfillment throughput, unit costs, vendor turnarounds, QC pass/fail rates) to executive leadership.</li> <li>Build business cases for infrastructure investments, automated tooling, and resource scaling to keep pace with growing catalog size and platform expansion.</li> <li>Codify operational playbooks, SOPs, and cross-territorial standards to harmonize workflows across regional and global offices.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Qualifications & Experience</strong></h2> <ul> <li>12+ years of professional experience in content operations, localization, media supply chain, or post-production leadership within OTT/streaming, entertainment, or digital media platforms.</li> <li>Proven track record leading multi-functional operations teams across localization/dubbing, asset management, content scheduling, and marketing operations.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to confidently navigate ambiguity, drive organizational change, and build scalable processes from scratch in a highly dynamic, high-growth environment. </li> <li>Extensive experience evaluating, onboarding, managing, and negotiating commercial agreements with global dubbing studios, post-production vendors, and localization agencies.</li> <li>Deep technical understanding of media localization pipelines (dubbing, subtitling, audio mixing, lip-syncing), digital asset management (DAM), CMS systems, and video ingestion formats.</li> <li>Demonstrated capability in building rigorous QC processes for customer-facing localized assets, upholding brand standards, and maintaining local cultural voice across multiple regions.</li> <li>Strong analytical ability with hands-on experience utilizing operational dashboards, workflow metrics, and ROI analysis to streamline operations.</li> <li>Proven experience operating effectively in a global, matrixed organization with cross-functional partners in multiple time zones.</li> <li>Exceptional communication, leadership, and executive presentation skills.</li> <li>Fluency in English required</li> <li>Passion for anime, international pop culture, media, or entertainment ecosystems is a plus.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Media Production, Business Administration, or related field; MBA or Master's preferred.</li> </ul> <h2>Why you will love working at Crunchyroll</h2> <p>In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:</p> <ul> <li>Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.</li> <li>Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.</li> <li>Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance</li> <li>Health Saving Account HSA program</li> <li>Health care and dependent care FSA</li> <li>Employer paid commuter benefit</li> <li>Support program for new parents</li> <li>Pet insurance and some of our offices are pet friendly!</li> </ul> <p>#LifeAtCrunchyroll #LI-Hybrid #LI-remote </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3 data-pm-slice="1 1 []">About our Values</h3> <p>We want to be everything for someone rather than something for everyone and we do this by living and modeling our values in all that we do. We value</p> <ul> <li> <p>Courage. We believe that when we overcome fear, we enable our best selves.</p> </li> <li> <p>Curiosity. We are curious, which is the gateway to empathy, inclusion, and understanding.</p> </li> <li>Kaizen. We have a growth mindset committed to constant forward progress.</li> <li> <p>Service. We serve our community with humility, enabling joy and belonging for others.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Our commitment to diversity and inclusion</h3> <p>Our mission of helping people belong reflects our commitment to diversity & inclusion. It's just the way we do business.</p> <p>We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Crunchyroll. Pursuant to applicable law, we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.</p> <p>Crunchyroll, LLC is an independently operated joint venture between US-based Sony Pictures Entertainment, and Japan's Aniplex, a subsidiary of Sony Music Entertainment (Japan) Inc., both subsidiaries of Tokyo-based Sony Group Corporation.</p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">Questions about Crunchyroll’s hiring process? Please check out our Hiring FAQs: </em>&lt

description: <div class="content-intro"><div><span id="m_8220454926977230902gmail-docs-internal-guid-9a9f34f4-7fff-014a-c97c-98ca90610a47">Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.</span></div> <div> </div></div><div class="uil-fw-normal uil-ff-hind uil-fsz-16 lg:uil-fsz-18 uil-lh-bigger uil-color-grey-700"> <p>At Algolia, we're passionate about helping organisations create fast, relevant, and intuitive digital experiences. Algolia AI search powers millions of experiences across ecommerce, financial services, travel and hospitality, media, marketplaces, SaaS, and other enterprise applications.</p> <p> </p> <p>As a Partner Solutions Engineer (EMEA), you'll play a critical role in expanding the impact of our partner ecosystem. You'll serve as the primary technical advisor across all of our partner categories including: Systems Integrators (SIs), Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), Cloud Partners, OEM partners, and Resellers across the EMEA region, enabling them to build, sell, and deliver exceptional experiences powered by Algolia.</p> <p> </p> <p>This role combines technical consulting, partner enablement, solution validation, and relationship management. You'll work closely with Partner Managers, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and the global Partner Solutions Engineering team to help partners become trusted experts on the Algolia platform.</p> <p> </p> <p>While reporting into the global Solutions Engineering team, this role is dedicated to our Global Partner Team which covers our partners in EMEA, AMER, LATAM and APAC.  This is a chance to join a mature Partner Team which has delivered consistent results and value to the business for the past 5 years.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What You'll Do:</strong></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Enable and Empower Partners</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deliver technical onboarding and enablement programs for SI, ISV, and Cloud partners</li> <li>Act as the primary technical point of contact for strategic partners throughout their lifecycle with Algolia</li> <li>Provide ongoing technical guidance and best practices to ensure partners successfully implement and innovate using Algolia solutions.</li> <li>Develop scalable enablement materials, workshops, demos, and technical documentation for our partners</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Drive Technical Excellence Across the Partner Ecosystem</strong></p> <ul> <li>Evaluate, validate, and certify partner-built accelerators, integrations, and solutions </li> <li>Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to ensure partner solutions align with platform best practices</li> <li>Bring partner insight to Product and Engineering teams through our Partner Advisory Board or other mechanism</li> <li>Monitor the health and quality of partner technical assets and recommend improvements over time</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Evangelize New Capabilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Become an expert on new Algolia features and product releases</li> <li>Translate technical capabilities into compelling business value for both technical and executive audiences</li> <li>Prepare partners to confidently position, demonstrate, and sell new Algolia capabilities</li> <li>Deliver engaging technical demonstrations, webinars, workshops, and enablement sessions</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Support Partner-Led Sales Opportunities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide presales technical expertise for opportunities coming from our partners</li> <li>Assist partners with architecture discussions, solution design, demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, and technical discovery</li> <li>Partner with Sales and Partner Managers to help accelerate partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Build Strategic Relationships</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop trusted relationships with technical leaders and solution architects at strategic partner organizations</li> <li>Serve as the title: Computational Chemist (gn) @ Chemistry AI Venture, London
description: This an Atlantic portfolio venture. About the Venture This early-stage venture is building a discovery engine for chemistry, comprising a platform for running end-to-end simulations of chemical reaction systems, and a world model + agent stack that uses the simulation platform to discover new chemistry. Their goal is to build backend scientific data infrastructure to meet the demands of AI systems that can truly accelerate and automate the discovery layer of chemistry. Both founders hold PhDs in Chemistry from the University of Oxford, and the venture has already secured pre-seed funding. They are now building out their founding team. The Role As a Computational Chemist, you will play a central role in shaping the scientific foundations of the venture's technology, helping develop the computational methods and workflows that underpin its end-to-end chemical reaction simulation platform. You’ll work closely with researchers and engineers to integrate state-of-the-art computational chemistry methods with machine learning approaches, driving progress towards the venture's strategic and scientific objectives. You’ll take ownership of developing, validating and optimising the computational chemistry components of the platform, with a particular focus on reaction mechanisms, reaction kinetics, molecular dynamics and the modelling of complex chemical environments. You will design, implement and refine scalable scientific workflows for generating, processing and analysing chemical reaction data, improving the accuracy, reliability and computational efficiency of simulations. Beyond your core scientific responsibilities, the team is looking for someone who can contribute to strategic research decisions, bring strong independent scientific judgement, and help shape the interdisciplinary research culture of the company at an early stage. What You'll Work On Foundation models for chemical reactivity: The team is building and training foundation models for chemical reactivity with a variety of data modalities. You'll help curate this foundational data corpus by developing cheminformatics and computational chemistry workflows for generating data from combinatorial enumeration, as well as robust data filtering, clustering and validation routines. Computational methods: The team is working on efficient computational methods from which foundational data is generated and the platform is validated. You'll be responsible for developing protocols for estimating solvation and entropy factors in chemical reaction steps. This involves keeping up to date with published literature for ideas and inspiration. Generative models: The venture is expanding its foundational data corpus beyond combinatorial workflows. You'll help design, validate and benchmark the generative model architectures that accomplish this. Chemical reaction simulation: The team is building out an end-to-end chemical reaction simulation platform. You'll be involved in designing the architecture and assembling the platform, as well as developing benchmarks and validation protocols against computational and experimental methods. World models and agents: The venture will be developing an agent + world model stack that operates on the simulation platform. You'll be responsible for formulating the action space in which the world model is trained and the agent explores new chemical reaction space. What They're Looking For The team is looking for someone who enjoys being given a blank canvas and the chance to create something spectacular with it. description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Data Enrichment Platform Team Our Enrichment Orchestration team builds the platform that enables Wayve’s teams to deploy, run, evaluate and continually improve machine-learning models. Processing petabytes of driving data across large GPU fleets, the team creates dependable, self-service capabilities that help model engineers understand model performance, improve quality and reduce operational effort and cost. As our Staff Software Engineer, you’ll own the platform’s technical vision and long-term direction. Lead the design, development and operation of backend services, APIs, model-execution workflows, versioned outputs, annotation capabilities and dataset catalogues. Make architectural decisions for petabyte-scale data and large GPU fleets, addressing data locality, scheduling, capacity, backpressure, failure recovery, observability and cost. Evaluate when to build, buy, reuse, integrate, consolidate or replace technologies as Wayve’s needs and the technology landscape evolve. Establish clear technical boundaries and ownership across model engineering, AI Platform, infrastructure, compute, storage and data teams. Remain hands-on while leading cross-team delivery, mentoring senior engineers and raising standards for maintainable, tested and observable software. Drive adoption of reusable, self-service capabilities so teams can onboard and operate workflows independently. Define measurable service levels and success metrics covering reliability, throughput, cost, automation and adoption. 🧩 What you’ll be working on A scalable platform for large-scale inference, automated evaluation, model monitoring, active learning and retraining. Self-service backend services and APIs that enable dozens of model engineers to deploy and operate repeatable workflows independently. Reproducible dataset selection, versioned outputs, annotation workflows and dataset catalogues with clear metadata, provenance and lineage. Reliable model-execution workflows operating across petabytes of driving data and large GPU fleets, scaling towards thousands of GPUs. Monitoring and operational tooling that make model quality, platform reliability, throughput, cost, runtime and workflow status visible. The foundations for continuous evaluation, drift detection and automated model-improvement loops across robotics and computer-vision workloads. Architectural improvements that reduce inference costs, duplicate compute and manual operational effort. 🙌 You should apply if You have owned the long-term technical direction of a complex, multi-system platform or capability and can demonstrate the measurable outcomes of your decisions. You have strong production software-engineering experience in Python, building maintainable, tested and observable backend services, APIs and data-processing systems. You have deep experience designing and operating large-scale distributed systems for data-intensive or compute-intensive workloads. You have a track record of turning internal platforms into widely adopted, reliable and usable self-service products. You bring excellent architecture and technology judgement, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term platform direction. You remain hands-on while leading delivery across organisational boundaries, influencing technical decisions and aligning teams around clear ownership and shared outcomes. You communicate complex ideas clearly and have experience mentoring senior engineers and strengthening the technical capabilities of those around you. Experience with workflow orchestration, batch inference, ML platforms, model deployment or registries would be an advantage. Relevant technologies include Flyte, Airflow, Dagster, Argo, Spark, Databricks, Ray, Kubernetes and GPU infrastructure. Experience with annotation or dataset-catalogue platforms, including provenance, versioning, lineage and quality control, would also be valuable. Experience with production robotics or computer-vision platforms—including annotation, inference, evaluation and model monitoring—is particularly desirable. Computer-vision research expertise is not required. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and the impact you could make at Wayve, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end-to-end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real-world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand-coded rules or pre-mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once-in-a-generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human-driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware-agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2+ through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real-world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻 — Locations & Flexible Working This role is based in London. Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. 🔍 The Interview Process Our process is clear and respectful of your time. Initial call / Talent Partner screen (30 mins) Competency interviews: Python coding (60 mins), System design (60 mins) Deep Dive Interviews: Technical Leadership, Hiring Manager interview (45 mins) Final interview: Mission, values and Staff-level calibration (45 mins) We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (location dependent) 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long-term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands-on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
description: At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge? As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly. This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job. Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices. What You'll Work On You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include: Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist. What Success Looks Like Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable. Who We're Looking For We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious. Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning No active backlogs Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++ Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before. Our Culture More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. We look for people who are curious enough to keep asking why, analytical enough to separate signal from noise, persistent enough to pursue difficult problems, intellectually honest enough to abandon an idea when the evidence says so, and humble enough to keep learning. At Graviton, researchers sit alongside technologists on specialized trading teams that operate with significant autonomy. You'll have meaningful ownership of research problems from day one: forming your own hypotheses, challenging existing approaches and following the evidence wherever it leads, with the infrastructure and datasets to test ideas at scale, competitive compensation, and a culture where the best idea wins regardless of who proposed it. Markets are among the most complex systems humans have ever created, and they never stop changing. Neither should our thinking. Every day, someone asks a better question and finds an answer nobody had. That someone could be you. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Quality Systems Lead
description: About us Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator. The role We're hiring a Quality Systems Lead to own how Encord measures the quality of the human data we deliver to frontier AI labs, physical AI companies and enterprise AI teams — the standard itself, the systems that evaluate against it, and the audit function that produces the ground truth behind both. Data quality is what our customers buy. As we scale across data types — image and video, document, medical, LLM evaluation, robot teleoperation, egocentric capture — quality coverage cannot scale linearly with headcount. So this role has two halves that make each other work. You will build automated evaluation: model-assisted and LLM-based screening, agreement analysis at scale, anomaly and drift detection across annotation output. And you will build and run a dedicated audit team of around ten specialists in India, whose judgements become the labelled ground truth that trains and calibrates that automated layer. As coverage automates, the audit team moves up to the cases models can't judge and to generating gold sets for each new data type we take on. Strong experience with recommender systems, search, ranking or matching (e.g. learning-to-rank, scoring models, Gradient Boosting Trees, embedding models). Fluency in evaluation: designing datasets and quality metrics (such as AUC, NDCG, precision and recall), and using LLM-as-a-judge and human feedback. A strong foundation in NLP and GenAI, including Transformers, LLMs and embedding models (training or fine-tuning them is a strong plus). High-quality software development skills in Python (clean design, testing, packaging, maintainable code etc.), practical knowledge of CI/CD, and hands-on experience with agentic coding, with the judgement to know when AI-generated code is right or wrong. The ability to simplify complex problems, to work with ambiguity, and to collaborate with data scientists, engineers, product managers and business stakeholders. A Master's degree or PhD, or equivalent experience, in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics or a related field. Nice to Have Experience with explainable or conversational recommendations. Experience in HR Tech, talent acquisition or workforce data. Publications, open-source contributions or strong results in ML challenges (e.g. RecSys, Kaggle). title: Senior Consumer Duty Specialist
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. About the role In this role, you will play a central part in assessing, questioning, and enhancing how customers experience Pleo. Drawing on deep regulatory knowledge, you will lead Consumer Duty initiatives, actively spot potential customer harm, examine what drives customer journeys, and ensure targeted remediation creates lasting, positive impact. You'll need sharp analytical skills and the confidence to influence stakeholders, translating data and MI into decisive action. You will construct and manage dashboards and reporting mechanisms that illuminate emerging patterns, vulnerable customer risks, and key concerns, offering executive leadership clear visibility into operational gaps and necessary solutions. Your contribution goes well beyond producing MI. You will conduct QA across complex complaint handling and sensitive customer interactions, manage Ombudsman cases, and speak up when evidence shows outcomes aren't meeting expectations. Collaborating across teams, you'll turn data-driven insights into practical improvements, drive projects to completion, and evaluate whether changes deliver real results for our users. We're seeking someone who views Consumer Duty as a powerful driver of business improvement rather than a routine compliance exercise. You'll bring together technical understanding, rigorous analysis, and constructive challenge to investigate root causes, align key partners, deliver change, and prove that customer experiences are continuously getting better. Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You'll work closely with teams across Customer Support, Complaints, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Product, Data, Technology, and other business functions. The role will have broad exposure across the organisation, particularly when customer outcome risks or Consumer Duty-related remediation require cross-functional action. You'll also work closely with senior stakeholders through Consumer Duty governance and reporting, helping translate detailed analysis into clear insights, risks, recommendations, and actions. What you’ll be doing As a Consumer Duty Specialist, you will: Turn data into customer outcome insight : Build and own MI, dashboards, KPIs, and reporting that give the business a clear view of customer outcomes, trends, risks, and emerging areas of concern. Own Consumer Duty reporting : Produce monthly and quarterly Consumer Duty reporting, turning complex data into a clear story for senior leadership and Board-level audiences. You'll go beyond showing what happened to explain why it matters and what we should do about it . Identify customer harm : Use complaints, QA findings, customer feedback, vulnerable customer data, Ombudsman cases, and MI to identify potential customer harm, emerging risks, and systemic issues. Challenge the business : Where the evidence suggests customers aren't receiving good outcomes, you'll be expected to ask difficult questions, challenge assumptions, and ensure the issue is properly understood and addressed. Drive remediation and change : Work with stakeholders across the business to agree remediation plans, establish clear owners and timelines, and help drive Consumer Duty-related projects and improvements through to completion. Provide complaints QA : Conduct weekly quality reviews of complaints handled by the Complaints Manager, using findings to identify quality issues, customer risks, and wider trends. Manage Ombudsman activity : Act as the primary operational contact with the UK Ombudsman, managing referred complaints, responses, remedies, compensation, invoices, and related communications. Leverage AI and smart automation : Spot opportunities to apply automated tools and AI to scale and streamline Consumer Duty analytics, monitoring, and workflows. You will feel empowered to test emerging tech and eliminate repetitive manual work, maintaining proper critical evaluation and human governance whenever compliance risks or customer impacts are involved. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: Strong Consumer Duty knowledge : You understand the principles of Consumer Duty and how they translate into practical customer outcomes, particularly across complaints, customer support, vulnerable customers, and customer journeys. Strong data and MI experience : You know how to take complex data, build meaningful dashboards and reporting, and identify the insights that actually matter. You're comfortable working with data rather than simply consuming reports created by others. A customer outcome mindset : You're naturally curious about how customers are experiencing the business and are able to connect data, customer feedback, complaints, and operational activity to real customer outcomes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills : You can spot trends, anomalies, and patterns, investigate root causes, and determine whether an issue is isolated or potentially systemic. The confidence to challenge : You're comfortable questioning decisions, processes, and assumptions when the evidence suggests customers may be experiencing poor outcomes. You can challenge constructively and build relationships at the same time. A bias towards action : You don't believe reporting is the end of the process. You want to understand what needs to change, bring people together, and help make it happen. Project and remediation experience : You're comfortable managing actions, timelines, dependencies, stakeholders, and risks across cross-functional projects, particularly where there is a regulatory, customer, or operational outcome to deliver. An AI and automation mindset : You're naturally curious about how AI and automation can make processes more efficient, improve analysis, and free up time for higher-value work. You look for sensible opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and use AI to augment your thinking, while maintaining appropriate human oversight, critical judgement, and accountability — particularly where customer outcomes or regulatory decisions are involved. Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You love using data to uncover things that others might not see. You want your analysis to drive real change, rather than sit in a report or dashboard. You enjoy asking "why?" and getting to the root cause of customer problems. You're comfortable challenging the business when the evidence tells you something isn't working. This role is not a good fit for you if: You prefer to produce reporting without being involved in what happens afterwards. You're uncomfortable challenging stakeholders or having difficult conversations when customer outcomes aren't where they should be. You prefer working within a narrow functional remit rather than across multiple teams. How you’ll develop in this role In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll: Build a deep understanding of our customer outcome data, existing Consumer Duty MI, complaints, vulnerable customer journeys, and current areas of risk. Take ownership of key Consumer Duty dashboards and reporting, developing a clear view of the metrics and insights that matter most. Establish strong relationships with stakeholders across Customer Support, Complaints, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Product, Data, and Technology. Lead the analysis behind Consumer Duty reporting and help shape how customer outcomes are presented to senior stakeholders and the Board. Over time, you'll have the opportunity to shape how Pleo measures, understands, and improves customer outcomes, helping move Consumer Duty from a regulatory obligation into a genuine driver of better customer experiences and better business decisions. Show me the benefits! Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background. Meet the Hiring Manager: 1hr going through role in more depth. Pleo Challenge: A case study were you talk us through how you'd solve a work appropriate challenge. Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! Last time we advertised this role, we received a really high volume of applications but could only select so many. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include: CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background! Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t

title: Sales Account Executive
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍London | 💰£67,000 Total OTE (base salary + commission) <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a> | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> ✨<strong><br><br></strong></p> <p><strong>⭐ About our Business Banking Sales team</strong></p> <p>We are rapidly growing and now serve over 730,000 businesses in the UK 🇬🇧</p> <p>In order to support the next phase of our expansion, we’re hiring a small team of experienced <strong>Sales Account Executives</strong>, whose mission is to reach out and support more complex high value customers with a personalised experience. </p> <p>We’re building an acquisition engine and your job will be to work with small-medium business (SMB) prospective customers, guide them through their buying journey, work with them to activate their account and bring all their banking needs to Monzo. </p> <p>This is an exciting opportunity to be a part of the founding sales team for a mission driven company , which is changing how people and businesses bank. </p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by…</strong></p> <ul> <li>Engaging with prospective SMB customers through discovery calls, and understand their business, challenges, goals and requirements.</li> <li>Driving full sales cycle, from early prospecting and qualification; to demos and sales;  to ensuring successful account switch and activation.</li> <li>Guiding customers through Monzo’s business banking offerings - providing clear, factual information and helping them evaluate what works best.</li> <li>Being a product expert: fully understand Monzo's business banking products, features and services.</li> <li>Managing a pipeline of leads with strong attention to data hygiene: timely follow-ups, accurate forecasting, deal tracking.</li> <li>Driving activation: not just closing, but ensuring new business customers are fully set up, onboarded, and are using Monzo for their banking needs.</li> <li>Collaborating internally: work closely with marketing, product, risk and customer operations to ensure a smooth journey for customers.</li> <li>Delivering outstanding service at every touchpoint: via phone, video, email or digital channels.</li> <li>Achieving sales targets: conversion, activations, revenue, engagement and other growth metrics as set by the commercial leadership.</li> <li>Feeding insights back: capture and share customer feedback — customer pain points, required features, suggestions for product improvements.</li> <li>Adapting & iterate: Things will change rapidly and often - you’ll need to be comfortable with ambiguity and change and help support what comes next.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you...</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have experience in Small Business sales, ideally selling business solutions or financial services; knowing how to engage business customers and understand their mindset, needs and pain points.</li> <li>Have a proven track record of meeting (or exceeding) sales quotas / targets in a performance-driven environment.</li> <li>Are an expert at managing a full sales cycle: from prospecting to activation, including structured and rigorous outreach and follow-ups and cross-team coordination.</li> <li>Have high emotional intelligence and are able to quickly connect and build a relationship with customers of diverse backgrounds and levels of knowledge.</li> <li>Are a strategic communicator,  excellent at building trust and helping customers discover value - you’re consultative, you listen, you ask insightful questions.</li> <li>Are adaptable and resilient, you embrace change and have a strong winning mindset to see challenges as opportunities to learn and grow.</li> <li>Can communicate clearly: written, verbal, via video; you simplify complex topics for customers.</li> <li>Are coachable and comfortable seeking constructive criticism to empower continuous learning and improvement</li> <li>Are comfortable working in a fast-moving, high change environment. You thrive when things aren’t fully defined yet.</li> <li>Can demonstrate high levels of personal organisation: tracking your pipeline, managing your time, prioritising your leads and follow-up tasks.</li> <li>Have integrity and strong consumer duty awareness: regulatory compliance, knowing your customer, reducing risk, safeguarding data and ensuring we put consumer duty first are foundational to this role and our culture.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus / Nice-to-haves:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience in a regulated environment (banking)</li> <li>Experience with Salesforce</li> <li>Familiarity with SMBs in specific verticals (e.g. food & drink, professional services, construction)</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £67,000 Total OTE (base salary + commission)</p> <p>📍 4 days a week in our London office but with occasional flexibility to work remotely (in the UK)</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has the following key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Phone call with recruiter (30 mins)</li> <li>Sales experience video interview with Sales Lead (45 mins)</li> <li>In-person assessment: Practical task assessment + Team and Culture fit interview (90 mins)</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4-6 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo 🤖 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>#LI-NZ1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Senior Engagement Manager
description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. About the Role The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the centre of that transformation. We're looking for an experienced Engagement Manager to own Legora's global relationship with one of the Big 4, one of our most significant partnerships, and to fundamentally change the way that firm works with Legora. This is a role for someone who has led change inside large, complex organisations and knows that real transformation is designed and managed. You will own the adoption and long-term success of this client globally: building the relationships, defining the outcomes and serving as the trusted adviser and orchestrator who turns Legora into an embedded part of how their teams operate. Global means global. You will set the strategy for how the firm adopts Legora worldwide, and Engagement Managers in other regions will run their local programmes against the direction and decisions you set. Day to day, you will be the point of contact for the firm's UK and Ireland practice from our London office, and you will travel regularly to other member firms in the network to build those relationships and land the programme on the ground. Expect to be travelling around 25% of the time. At the heart of the role is designing the client's adoption playbook and delivering a multi-year change-management programme that transforms how they work. You will build the roadmap, sequence initiatives from initial rollout through firm-wide scaled adoption, define measurable outcomes and ROI and evolve the programme as new AI capabilities and use cases emerge. You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class adoption programme at Legora, helping the client realise measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work. title: Senior Director, International Global Partnerships
description: Monster Jam is the world’s premier monster truck entertainment property, delivering unforgettable live events, iconic trucks, and family experiences to millions of fans around the globe. As the brand continues to expand across Europe, we are seeking a dynamic Franchise Manager to lead integrated growth initiatives spanning marketing, consumer products, retail partnerships, and toy/category development. The Senior Director, International Global Partnerships, will lead the strategic growth of the Monster Jam brand across key European markets through integrated franchise marketing, retail activation, consumer products expansion, and cross-functional partnership management. This role is responsible for building cohesive programs that drive brand awareness, increase toy and merchandise penetration, strengthen retailer relationships, and ultimately accelerate event attendance and ticket sales. The ideal candidate is a commercially minded brand builder with experience managing entertainment, toy, sports, family, or lifestyle franchises across multiple territories. This individual will work closely with the Monster Jam consumer products team, regional promoters, retail partners, regional licensees and the Spin Master toy organization to create coordinated campaigns that put Monster Jam products into the hands of consumers while amplifying engagement with the brand within all franchise touchpoints including the live event business. Essential Functions Franchise & Brand Marketing Develop and execute the European franchise growth strategy for Monster Jam across key markets and retail channels. Lead integrated marketing initiatives that increase awareness, fan engagement, and affinity for the Monster Jam brand. Partner with regional event, marketing, and ticketing teams to align campaigns that drive attendance and revenue growth. Create scalable promotional programs that connect consumer products, retail activations, digital marketing, and live events. Identify market-specific opportunities to grow audience reach, including localized campaigns, partnerships, and experiential activations. Serve as a steward of the Monster Jam brand across all consumer-facing touchpoints. Consumer Products & Licensing Support the expansion of the Monster Jam consumer products business throughout Europe. Identify opportunities for new product categories, retail exclusives, promotions, and licensing partnerships. Collaborate with internal licensing and consumer products stakeholders to maximize shelf presence and category performance. Analyze market trends, retail performance, and consumer insights to inform product and franchise strategies. Develop annual plans and commercial initiatives that support long-term franchise growth. Retail Partnerships & Programs Build and manage strategic relationships with major European retailers and distribution partners. Develop retail marketing programs that elevate visibility, support product launches, and drive sell-through. Partner with retailers on seasonal campaigns, in-store activations, sweepstakes, promotions, and event tie-ins. Coordinate retailer-specific marketing assets, promotional calendars, and execution plans. Monitor retail performance metrics and identify opportunities to optimize programs and increase market penetration. Spin Master Partnership Management Act as the primary liaison with the Spin Master toy team across Europe and North America for product development for regional needs. Partner closely on go-to-market planning, product launches, marketing campaigns, and retail initiatives. Communicate regional market insights, fan trends, and retailer feedback to support product development and commercial planning. Drive initiatives that increase toy awareness, distribution, and consumer adoption across Europe. Champion the shared vision of placing a Monster Jam toy in every child’s hands to fuel broader franchise engagement and live event attendance. Cross-Functional Leadership Collaborate with internal teams, including marketing, events, ticketing, licensing, finance, and operations, to ensure alignment across all franchise initiatives. Lead project timelines, campaign execution, and stakeholder communication across multiple markets and partners. Present business updates, market insights, and growth opportunities to senior leadership. Manage agency and external partner relationships where applicable. Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Entertainment Management, or related field. 5–8+ years of experience in franchise marketing, brand management, consumer products, licensing, retail marketing, or related fields. Experience working with entertainment, toy, sports, gaming, family, or lifestyle brands preferred. Strong understanding of European retail landscapes and consumer markets. Proven ability to manage cross-functional partnerships and external stakeholders. Experience collaborating with major retailers and consumer products organizations. Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate brand strategy into measurable business growth. Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship management skills. Ability to manage multiple projects across international markets in a fast-paced environment. Willingness to travel across Europe and internationally as needed. Success Metrics Growth in Monster Jam brand awareness across European markets. Increased consumer products and toy sales performance. Expansion and effectiveness of retail partnerships and promotional programs. Measurable contribution to event attendance and ticket sales growth. Successful execution of integrated franchise marketing initiatives. Strengthened collaboration and strategic alignment with the Spin Master partnership team. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Data Engineer - Real time analytics
description: Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace. Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence. Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines. At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth. How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here. We are looking for an engaged and passionate Senior Data Engineer to join our growing Engineering Team. In this role, you will be a key member of the team managing our analytics and event platform stack. As part of the Analytics & Data Platform team, you will build features for over 22,000 customers across the globe. Your work will unlock the value of data, empowering our customers to make informed decisions through real-time insights, monitoring, and comprehensive analytical reports. Your role at Aircall Have key responsibilities within the requirements analysis, scalable & low latency streaming platform solution design, architecture, and end-to-end delivery of key modules in order to provide near real-time data solutions for our product Analyze and translate business needs into data model & optimize for big data Identify slow queries and optimize for better performance Write clean scalable code using Scala / python / SQL and test and deploy applications and systems Solve our most challenging data problems, in near real-time, utilizing optimal data architectures, frameworks, query techniques, sourcing from structured and unstructured data sources. workflows across reconciliations, invoice processing, variance analysis, and reporting drafts Leveraging AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to speed up your own work and build the systems that let finance scale without adding headcount Acting as the financial conscience of the business , with a direct line to the founders and a real say in how we grow What we’re looking for Qualified accountant
